snippet.title: Ping&Pong - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ping&Pong demo is available now! 🎮
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4401460/PingPong/

Play it now on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist the game, it helps a lot at this stage of development.
